description: Scorecards giving the probability that a candidate bridge redraws a missing stroke, one per bridge shape. log-odds = intercept + sum of weight * (transform(value) - mean) / scale. Fitted by train_scoring.py.

features.name: mutual_nearest
features.meaning: share of the two ends for which the other is the nearest free end

features.name: nearest_ratio
features.meaning: gap length relative to the distance from each end to its nearest free end

features.name: same_stroke
features.meaning: the two ends belong to one stroke (1 = yes: the bridge closes it)

features.name: crossed_ink
features.meaning: existing stroke the bridge runs over between its ends, in stroke widths

features.name: aim_worst
features.meaning: degrees by which the worse-aimed end points away from the other end

features.name: aim_best
features.meaning: degrees by which the better-aimed end points away from the other end

features.name: sideways_offset
features.meaning: stroke widths by which one stroke, continued straight, passes beside the other end

features.name: mdtw
features.meaning: MDTW: deviation of the bridge and the stroke on either side from a straight line

features.name: mjerk
features.meaning: MJerk: abruptness of the change of curvature along the bridge and the stroke on either side

features.name: width_mismatch
features.meaning: width of the wider stroke relative to the narrower

features.name: nearest_ratio
features.meaning: gap length relative to the distance from each end to its nearest free end

features.name: same_stroke
features.meaning: the two ends belong to one stroke (1 = yes: the bridge closes it)

features.name: crossed_ink
features.meaning: existing stroke the bridge runs over between its ends, in stroke widths

features.name: corner_turn
features.meaning: change of direction at the corner, in degrees

features.name: corner_detour
features.meaning: extra length of the corner bridge over the straight gap, in gap lengths

features.name: corner_balance
features.meaning: how unequal the two legs of the corner are (0 = equal, 1 = one leg only)

features.name: corner_bend
features.meaning: how curved the two strokes are where the corner bridge meets them (0 = straight)

training.threshold_rule: a bridge is drawn when it is at least 2 times as likely to be right as wrong
